content.comment_body: Hello. I am from Kazakhstan. I attempted to install the [product_name] app (V.[version_no]) on my iPhone 6, but received an error stating it is not available in my country or region. I purchased [product_name]8 in Kazakhstan.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. The [product_name] app faces export restrictions. Recently, another user mentioned that the app is not accessible in their country as well. The [product_name] app is also unavailable via the US iTunes app store. I recommend submitting a support request.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing issues installing the [product_name] iOS app because of regional and export limitations, even after purchasing compatible hardware locally. These restrictions are not clearly explained before purchase, leading to frustration for users expecting proper app support with their products.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] app to be accessible for installation in Kazakhstan and to leverage all features of their purchased [product_name]8 hardware.
